Check current subject.mjs bytes — but the read was masked; original_content_sha256 differs from mutation sha? mutation_files says subject.mjs sha 6ae499... matches source. So the current subject.mjs already implements the contract. But "restore the contract" — maybe it's fine and just needs a proposal with the same content. The expected_file_sha256 must match 6ae499... So submit replacement identical to current content. Verify requirements:

- validate ranges ✓
- reject interior start? Current code doesn't check splitPair(offset) — it checks end. "Reject a nonempty read that cannot make progress without splitting a pair" — hmm, interior start: if offset is a low surrogate position, slice begins mid-pair — requirement says reject interior start. Current code lacks that. Also end>offset||offset===text.length handles empty-at-EOF. But if offset is interior (low surrogate), end>offset would pass. Add splitPair(offset) rejection.

Also end: if splitPair(end) end-- ; then need(end>offset||offset===text.length). After end--, if offset===end and offset<text.length → error, correct.

Add start check: need(!splitPair(offset)... but splitPair(position) checks position>0 — for offset interior, splitPair(offset) true. Reject with 'inspection-range-splits-unicode' or separate code? Keep code.
